name: Glass Shatter
description: Under a single hard light the body turns to glass and bursts into a thousand glittering shards.

wardrobe.man: a fitted black turtleneck and black trousers
wardrobe.woman: a fitted black turtleneck and black trousers
wardrobe.person: a fitted black turtleneck and black trousers

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. {references} The {subject} is the only person in the new still, with exactly {their} face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline, hairstyle, hair colour{facial_hair}, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. The clothing, the place and the light come only from this description. The {subject} stands alone in a black studio void on a glossy black floor, facing the camera, wearing {wardrobe}, arms relaxed. A single hard white light from directly above draws a sharp pool of light around {their} feet and a bright rim on the head and shoulders, and the background fades to pure black. Medium-wide shot at eye level, the {subject} centered, full body visible, the reflection on the floor below. Cinematic high-contrast studio photography, hard top light, deep blacks. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, a seamless black background throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} ALREADY stands still in the pool of light, eyes on a point just past the camera. The skin and the clothes turn into flawless clear glass from the chest outward, until the whole figure is a transparent glass sculpture that bends the light and throws bright caustics on the floor. Then, in slow motion, the glass figure bursts outward into thousands of sharp glittering shards that fly toward the camera and to the sides, catch the hard light and rain down onto the glossy floor, until by the last second only a scatter of shards glitters where the {subject} stood. The camera holds a steady medium-wide shot. Sound: a high crystalline ring, one huge burst of breaking glass, a long tinkling rain of shards. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, glass with real refraction and shard physics, slow motion, sharp detail, stable picture.
generic_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} in the frame stays still. The skin and the clothes turn into flawless clear glass, until the whole figure is a transparent glass sculpture that bends the light. Then, in slow motion, the glass figure bursts outward into thousands of sharp glittering shards that fly out and rain down, until by the last second only a scatter of shards glitters where the {subject} stood. The camera keeps the same framing and the same movement it already has. Sound: a high crystalline ring, one huge burst of breaking glass, tinkling shards. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, glass with real refraction and shard physics, slow motion, sharp detail, stable picture.
